# A bar stool: a round red leather seat (10 sides, 0.38 m across) at 0.72 m, three wooden legs
# splayed a little, a wooden footring. Generated by make_env.py. Up Z, origin on the floor.
new
material new Seat --base-color 1.0000 0.0000 0.0000 --no-slot
material new Wood --base-color 0.6275 0.3137 0.0000 --no-slot
add mesh cylinder --name Seat --vertices 10 --radius 0.19 --depth 0.09 --location 0 0 0.715
material assign Seat
add mesh cube --name L0 --size 1 --location 0.0000 0.1300 0.335
scale 0.05 0.05 0.68
apply --scale
set rotation -5.000 0.000 0
apply --rotation
add mesh cube --name L1 --size 1 --location -0.1126 -0.0650 0.335
scale 0.05 0.05 0.68
apply --scale
set rotation 2.500 -4.330 0
apply --rotation
add mesh cube --name L2 --size 1 --location 0.1126 -0.0650 0.335
scale 0.05 0.05 0.68
apply --scale
set rotation 2.500 4.330 0
apply --rotation
add mesh cylinder --name Ring --vertices 10 --radius 0.15 --depth 0.04 --location 0 0 0.26
select L0 L1 L2 Ring
material assign Wood
select Ring
active Ring
mode edit
select face where "abs(normal.z) > 0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
select Seat L0 L1 L2 Ring
active Seat
join
select Seat
active Seat
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
shade flat
export stool.glb
